operations.trigger: Close menu, primary or hidden accelerator

behavior: Both schemas delegate to the same CZe close helper with accelerator and triggeredByAccelerator boolean.
If accelerator matches closeTab, first try focused shell panel via He/FR, then browserHostManager.closeFocusedVisibleBrowserTab, then FR fallback; successful branches return.
FR may return close-active-app-shell-tab for closable main/bottom/right panel. RR delegates selected panel derivation to IR when optional overrides are absent.
Fallback rereads focused window and requests requestCloseWindow when valid. y1e forwards to windowCloseConfirmation.requestClose.

Selected uYe.requestClose records keyboardRequests during win.close() and clears it in finally. Native close events and any confirmation hooks remain delegated. The independently selected n_e.requestClose belongs to another owner and is not joined to this chain.
conditions: closeTab match depends on configured platform accelerators; window destruction/focus changes and panel/browser state affect precedence.
failureAndCancellation: No valid final focused window yields no native close request; panel/browser success prevents window fallback.
win.close() is not proof of closed/destroyed window; cancellation/preventDefault and confirmation handling need owner/runtime evidence.
knownGaps: IR effective panel choice, injected browser manager and complete close confirmation hooks; actual panel/browser/window cancellation and cleanup.
deduplication: Two schemas are one close operation with a hidden accelerator alias.
FSC-0003 configures close-confirmation preference; it is not the close action itself. The goal includes focused target precedence instead of claiming every invocation closes a window.
